# neuron v0.1.7 — a hardening pass

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). The installer and portable ZIP include the tray app and CLI. The binaries are unsigned. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `SOURCE.txt` records the source commit.

No big new features this time. I went through neuron trying to break it: macro sandboxes, shared setup files, installs, updates, sleep, quitting. Then I fixed what fell out. This also picks up everything from v0.1.6, which never got published.

## What's better

- **Macros.** BOUND macros are properly sandboxed, can drive OBS and Signal lighting now, and tell you clearly whether an action actually happened.
- **Sharing setups.** Importing someone's setup or profile shows you anything that would run code or write to your device's memory, and asks before adding it.
- **Devices.** Newer BlackWidow keyboards (V3, V4 X) should get proper lighting, and M keys work on keyboards plugged in after neuron starts. I don't own those boards, so if you do, tell me how it goes!
- **Reliability.** No more false stall warnings after sleep, quitting from the tray is clean, and Chroma broker updates roll back properly if something goes wrong.

Addressed issues: #6, #11, #23, #30, #33.

## Install

Use the installer, or unpack the portable ZIP into a writable folder and run `neuron-app.exe`.

Still the Windows beta. [Feature status and platform limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.7/docs/STATUS.md).

- `neuron-v0.1.7-windows-x86_64-setup.exe`
- `neuron-v0.1.7-windows-x86_64.zip`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
